lessonTitle: What AI can bring to Medical Affairs

slides.title: AI Is Now a Daily Working Tool
bullets: Generative AI has moved from future promise to daily MSL tool
Understanding its real value is now a competitive advantage
The key skill is knowing which tasks it helps with, and which it doesn't
Using it without criteria erases that advantage

slides.title: Four High-Value Use Cases
bullets: Synthesizing and organizing information: literature, field notes, insights
Early exploration of an unfamiliar topic or research question
First drafts of support materials: slides, FAQ outlines, education content
Analyzing an MSL's own long documents: protocols, reports, congress notes

slides.title: Hallucination Is the Central Risk
bullets: Models can generate confident, scientific-sounding content that is wrong
Fabricated facts or nonexistent citations are the classic failure mode
Risk rises with very specific or very recent information
No model replaces clinical judgment or primary source verification

slides.title: An Assistant, Not an Oracle
bullets: Think of AI as a productivity accelerator for low-risk, repetitive work
Not an authority that hands down verified scientific answers
It frees time for the work only a human MSL can do
Scientific judgment, KOL relationships, and final verification stay human

slides.title: This Module's Roadmap
bullets: Each following lesson covers one tool: strengths, failure points, workflow fit
The module closes with compliance and privacy risks
One principle runs through all of it: accelerate, never replace, verify

takeaway.title: AI adds real value to Medical Affairs only when used for the right tasks, with human verification never skipped
bullets: AI excels at synthesis, exploration, drafting, and long-document review
Hallucination and unverified claims are the risk to always guard against
Treat AI as an accelerator, never a substitute for clinical judgment
